column1: # Readings of polyphonic characters when they stand alone as a one-character token.
# Format: char <TAB> reading <TAB> share. Shares of one character sum to 1.
# Used only to generate neural training data (training/neural/readings.py): the
# corpus has no pronunciation, so for these characters a reading is drawn at
# random with the given share. The shares are rough hand estimates; their job
# is to make sure the model sees every reading a typist may use.
# Characters not listed here use one fixed reading (see readings.py).
